name: ke-mpesa-reversal-dispute
description: Handle money sent to the wrong number or taken by fraud on mobile money in Kenya: what to do in the first minutes, how the reversal request works, what to say to the provider, what to do if the recipient refuses, and how to escalate to the police, the regulator or the small claims court. Use when asked I sent M-Pesa to the wrong number, how do I reverse an M-Pesa transaction, I was scammed on mobile money, nimetuma pesa kwa number mbaya, or the person refuses to return my money. Produces an immediate action list, the reversal request wording, a timeline log, a message to the recipient, and an escalation ladder with what each step needs. Not legal advice.
